A tap replacement was not explicitly approved by the landlord either.
message: Hello Ivo, thank you for the corrected invoice NBL-025-INV-15; the postcode now matches our record for 18 Thistlewick Row. Before we can process it, please could you send: (1) the date you attended and confirmation that the new mono kitchen tap was fitted and the drip is fixed; (2) the invoice amount itemised (labour, tap, VAT), as the document shows no amount and we hold no quote for it; (3) confirmation that you returned the spare key to our office. Please also confirm whether you noted anything about the cloudy water while you were there. Kind regards, Tessa Wren, Northbridge Lettings
